meta.name: lcx-report-bug
meta.description: Create a high-signal bug issue or PR in the repo that owns the defect. Use this whenever the user asks to report, file, open, or triage a LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, Codex plugin, or upstream Codex CLI bug, especially when they need source-backed root cause, reproduction steps, fix guidance, and GitHub routing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动创建带根因分析和复现步骤的缺陷报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在GitHub仓库中提交高质量Bug Issue或修复PR。
copy.tagline_en: Automatically create bug reports with root cause analysis and reproduction steps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to file high-signal bug issues or fix PRs in GitHub repos.

howto.what: 当你要报告 LazyCodex 或 Codex 相关 bug 时，它会先拉取最新源码并调查问题根源，判断该交给哪个 GitHub 仓库，然后生成一份英文 issue（或对 openai/codex 生成 PR），包含复现步骤、环境、根因、修复建议、验证计划及固定标签。
howto.when: 当你要求报告、提交或处理 LazyCodex、omo-codex、Codex 插件等 bug 时触发，尤其是需要查根源、复现步骤和确定提交到哪个仓库时。

say.text: 帮我给 LazyCodex 报 bug：安装后命令找不到，附上复现步骤和根因。
say.note: 会先同步源码，调查后生成 issue 草稿。

say.text: 调查这个 Codex 插件报错，确定发到哪个仓库，再起草 issue。
say.note: 会对照两份最新源码给出归属结论。

say.text: 如果在干净上游 Codex 能复现，就提交修复 PR。

howto.what_en: When asked to file a LazyCodex/Codex bug, it syncs latest source, investigates root cause, picks the owning GitHub repo, and drafts an English issue (or PR for openai/codex) with repro, environment, root cause, fix, and verification.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to report, file, open, or triage a bug in LazyCodex, omo-codex, or Codex plugins, etc., especially when root-cause analysis and repo routing are needed.

say_en.text: File LazyCodex bug: command missing after install; include repro and root cause.
say_en.note: It syncs sources, investigates, then drafts an issue.

say_en.text: This Codex plugin error should go to which repo? Draft the issue.
say_en.note: Compares both source checkouts before routing.

say_en.text: If it reproduces in clean upstream Codex, submit a fix PR there.
say_en.note: PRs only for openai/codex; LazyCodex repo gets issue.
